NSFWImageModerationClassifierUrl.description: Hugging Face image-classification endpoint (POST JSON {inputs: base64, parameters: {top_k: 2}}).

NSFWImageModerationAlwaysReject.description: When true, reject every image upload without calling the classifier.

NSFWImageModerationNsfwThreshold.description: Reject the upload when the Falconsai `nsfw` score is greater than or equal to this value.

NSFWImageModerationApiKey.description: Optional Bearer token sent as Authorization. Leave empty for a local nsfw_detector with no auth.
